text: This is ok.  Would work great for like goldfish crackers. This isn't very good for larger chips like doritos or potato chips.  It would be good for goldfish or cereal. It's a different product for sure!  It's a bit awkward, but I can see it working for the smaller items for kids.

product_metadata.title: KUFUNG Food Storage Sealing Clips with Pour Spouts, Kitchen Chip Bag Clips, Plastic Cap Sealer Clips, Great for Kitchen Food Storage and Organization (M, Blue)
features: 【High-quality Material】: Food storage sealing clips are safe food grade PP material, non-toxic and won't be easy to crack. Small size, light weight, easy to carry. Strong sealed performance, a simple but utility way to protect your food from moisture and dust.

【With Discharge Nozzle, Covenient To Pour Out】This plastic sealing clips with large-diameter pouring nozzle, easy for you to dump food, such as snacks candies, small chips, cornflakes, popcorn, chocolate, nuts, etc.) , dog food, coffee bean, cereals, rolled oats,pasta, flour, spice and seasonings... (Note: Pay more attention to Its Nozzle Dia=2 inch, If the food is too large, it may get stuck.)

【Keeping Food Fresh】: Flip top easy buckle cap/flip. Seals the freshness of bagged foods without removing the item from its original package.Perfect sealing effect to ensure the freshness of food, snacks, etc. This design seals the air and keeps the food fresh and crispy for several months.

【Easy to Install and Use】: You can easily install it on any plastic or paper bag, clamp it, and then seal the food or tilt the top cover to pour out the food. This simple and practical way to protect your food from moisture and dust.

【A Little Helper To Make Everything Neat】: Small in size, light in weight, easy to carry, can be use in kitchen, living room, office, dorm room, even in travel. Without making a mess. Great Gift Idea for many folks who want to make food sealing and pouring easier!
